name: train_parallel
description: Dispatch marker for the parallel bot training of .github/workflows/riftlab.yml (request=lab/specs/train_parallel.json, chain=N iterations). One iteration per workflow run: 1600 self-play games on 8 machines, the candidate trained on the last 3 iterations, then 6 mirror gate blocks, 5 panel matchups and 3 yardsticks on 14 machines; adopted at 55% (or an SPRT win) with at least 45% on the panel. From iteration 184: 30% of the self-play pairs are league games (the current net against one of the last 4 adopted nets, the 2 anchor nets or the material bot, seats alternated; only the current net's decisions recorded), and value data carries the search's root value (RBV4).
